primary.name: Equal-endpoint mean absolute reconstruction error in nuisance-matched corrected MI

If either endpoint has no reference support,the primary is null. All unsupported/mismatched patients remain reported.
primary.rationale: Matches what program.grade.compare actually measures: accurate numerical analysis and support accounting. This is not an effect-size reward,predictive score or scientific-reasoning grade.
